column1: # B2: DB_RMW on read-modify-write reads in the TPROC-C driver.
# Host: 8 vCPU (local), libdb 2026.10.1, btree, scale=4, t=8, 10s measured,
# 5s warmup, -d nosync. Arms ALTERNATED within each rep; one binary per arm
# differing only in get_rec vs get_rec_rmw at the six RMW sites.
# "before" = every read takes a READ lock and upgrades on the put.
# "after"  = the six reads whose record is written in the same txn use DB_RMW.
# retry_per_commit is the figure that matters: it is the deadlock rate the
# driver was manufacturing, independent of engine scalability.
#          (49x fewer). cv: before 10.0%, after 7.3% -- both arms stable, so
# errors: 0 in all five transaction types, both arms. payment -- 67.30% of
#          cycles at t=32 in the G13 profile -- goes to ZERO retries.
